name: Creature modifiers
description: Persistent descriptive variations for generated creatures

fields.description: The subject has the bearing of a dominant leader that coordinates peers and protects group cohesion.
The subject shows traits from a second species, suggesting one useful ability and a contradictory weakness.
The subject appears free of several biological needs and bound to the cause or rite of reanimation.
Armor, mutation, or magical protection visibly suggests unusual resilience against ordinary attacks.
The subject is extraordinarily large, with imposing reach and presence but difficulty in narrow spaces.
The subject appears recklessly aggressive after injury, dangerous in manner but increasingly predictable.
The encounter is narrated as a coordinated pack, without changing generated group size or mechanics.
The encounter is narrated as many small creatures acting as one threat, without changing generated group size or mechanics.
The subject appears partly able to cross matter but must seem material to affect the physical world.
The subject is hard to see, though scent, sound, and interaction with the surroundings may reveal it.
The subject manifest a RULE {{ rules }} which changes its appearance and abilities.
The subject appears to carry anatomy-appropriate weapons or objects; no equipment is selected or added.
It never becomes completely still and constantly watches its surroundings.
Thin smoke and dim embers drift from its body without an enforced mechanical effect.
A persistent layer of frost coats part of its body and nearby surfaces.
Its outline remains difficult to separate from the shadows around it.
